Layer.PlayBackgroundCommand: %function(self) self:decelerate(0.5) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetBackgroundPath() == nil then self:diffusealpha(0) else self:diffusealpha(1) end end end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) Center(self); self:zoom(1.5) self:addy(SCREEN_CENTER_Y*2); self:decelerate(0.5) self:addy(-SCREEN_CENTER_Y*2) end
%function(self) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y-155) self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X-240 ) self:addy(-400) self:decelerate(0.5) self:addy(400) end
